title: Data-file codegen metadata
description: Optional top-level `meta:` block in data yamls. Carries directives that drive codegen.

enum.description: Enums to emit from this file, one per entry.

cpp.description: The C++ enum to be generated.

underlying.description: Underlying integer type of the C++ enum.

class.description: Name of the C++ enum class.

case.description: Casing of the C++ member names.

lua.description: Emit the enum as a Lua table.

table.description: The fully qualified global Lua table name to be created for the enum.

section.description: Dotted path to the section holding the entries; `*` matches every entry at that level (`ecosystems.*.families` = the families of every ecosystem). Defaults to the filename.

name_from.description: Dot-path to a string inside each entry, slugged into the member name (e.g. `name.en`). When set, the YAML key is the integer id.
